title: Morin, a matrix metalloproteinase 9 inhibitor, attenuates endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in atherosclerosis by downregulating Notch-1 signaling.
authors: He, Yuan; Qin, Xiao-Xuan; Liu, Ming-Wei; Sun, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桑色素通过抑制MMP-9和Notch-1信号通路减轻动脉粥样硬化中的内皮-间质转化，属于心血管疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease poses a significant health challenge globally. Recent findings highlight the pivotal role of the endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndMT) in atherosclerosis. Morin is a bioflavonoid mainly extracted from white mulberry, a traditional Chinese herbal medicine with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. This study examines whether morin can alleviate atherosclerosis by suppressing EndMT and seeks to elucidate the underlying mechanism. METHODS: We induced an in vitro EndMT model in human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) by stimulating the cells with transforming growth factor-beta1 (TGF-beta1) (10 ng/mL) for 48 h. The in vivo experiments were performed in an atherosclerosis model using apolipoprotein E (ApoE)(-/-) mice fed with a high-fat diet (HFD). Mice in the intervention group were given morin (50 mg/kg) orally for 4 weeks. Molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis were assayed to understand the interactions between morin and matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9). RESULTS: Morin inhibited the expression of EndMT markers in a dose-dependent manner in TGF-beta1-treated HUVECs. Administering 50 mumol/L morin suppressed the upregulation of MMP-9 and Notch-1 signaling in TGF-beta1-induced EndMT. Moreover, the overexpression of MMP-9 activated Notch-1 signaling, thereby reversing morin's inhibitory effect on EndMT. In the HFD-induced atherosclerotic ApoE(-/-) mice, morin notably reduced aortic intimal hyperplasia and plaque formation by suppressing EndMT. Furthermore, morin demonstrated a strong binding affinity for MMP-9. CONCLUSION: Morin acts as an MMP-9 inhibitor to disrupt EndMT in atherosclerosis by limiting the activation of Notch-1 signaling. This study underscores morin's potential utility in the development of anti-atherosclerotic medication. Please cite this article as: He Y, Qin XX, Liu MW, Sun W. Morin, a matrix metalloproteinase 9 inhibitor, attenuates endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in atherosclerosis by downregulating Notch-1 Signaling. J Integr Med. 2024; 22(6): 684-696.
abstract_zh: 目的：动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病在全球范围内构成重大健康挑战。近期研究强调了内皮-间质转化（EndMT）在动脉粥样硬化中的关键作用。桑色素（Morin）是一种主要从白桑葚中提取的生物黄酮类化合物，白桑葚是一种具有抗炎和抗氧化特性的传统中草药。本研究探讨桑色素是否通过抑制EndMT来减轻动脉粥样硬化，并试图阐明其潜在机制。方法：我们通过用转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）（10 ng/mL）刺激人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）48小时，诱导了体外EndMT模型。体内实验在动脉粥样硬化模型中进行，使用高脂饮食（HFD）喂养的载脂蛋白E（ApoE）(-/-)小鼠。干预组小鼠口服桑色素（50 mg/kg）4周。通过分子对接和微量热泳动实验来了解桑色素与基质金属蛋白酶-9（MMP-9）之间的相互作用。结果：桑色素以剂量依赖性方式抑制了TGF-β1处理的HUVECs中EndMT标志物的表达。给予50 μmol/L桑色素抑制了TGF-β1诱导的EndMT中MMP-9和Notch-1信号的上调。此外，MMP-9的过表达激活了Notch-1信号，从而逆转了桑色素对EndMT的抑制作用。在HFD诱导的动脉粥样硬化ApoE(-/-)小鼠中，桑色素通过抑制EndMT显著减少了主动脉内膜增生和斑块形成。此外，桑色素表现出对MMP-9的强结合亲和力。结论：桑色素作为MMP-9抑制剂，通过限制Notch-1信号的激活来破坏动脉粥样硬化中的EndMT。本研究强调了桑色素在抗动脉粥样硬化药物开发中的潜在应用价值。请引用本文为：He Y, Qin XX, Liu MW, Sun W. Morin, a matrix metalloproteinase 9 inhibitor, attenuates endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in atherosclerosis by downregulating Notch-1 Signaling. J Integr Med. 2024; 22(6): 684-696.
